businesses.business: industrial distribution of metalworking and MRO supplies

offering_description.value: Distributes metalworking tools, cutting tools, abrasives, fasteners, safety gear and other maintenance, repair and operations (MRO) supplies to industrial customers. Sells to manufacturers and other businesses through catalogs, website, branches and on-site vending and inventory programs. Also provides inventory management and technical support.

primary_products.value: cutting tools; abrasives; fasteners; safety equipment; machinery and power tools; janitorial and MRO supplies

primary_services.value: vending and inventory management; technical application support; metalworking engineering and training

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers, machine shops, fabricators, and maintenance operations of industrial companies; B2G: government agencies and contractors

end_markets.value: general manufacturing; aerospace and defense; automotive; heavy equipment; energy; government

revenue_model.value: product sales: industrial supplies and tools sold to business customers; service fees: vending, inventory management and implementation programs

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys products from many suppliers and sells to industrial end users

geography_served.value: North America: United States primarily, plus Canada, Mexico and the UK

specialization.value: related lines: metalworking products, MRO supplies, safety and inventory solutions for industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: online: website and e-commerce integrations; direct sales: field sales reps, national accounts, on-site vending; own locations: branches and customer fulfillment centers; other: print catalogs and call centers
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; own locations; other

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules, plus government contracting and trade and product safety rules

notes: UK is listed in geography but is a smaller presence; Mexico and Canada operations are smaller.
